description: Upload one local file to automatically create extraction schemas/templates; use when the user authorized schema creation, which may consume credits. Returns run_id for get_quick_schema_creation or wait_for_quick_schema_creation, not an extraction task_id or export_job_id. Completed runs return generated template IDs and saved document IDs; inspect those before submitting another extraction. Supply upload_batch_id and source_upload_id only when provided by an external batched-upload workflow; MCP does not create upload batches. Starting again can create duplicate work.

file_path.description: Path to a local document on the machine running this MCP server, not a URL or chat attachment. Supported extensions: .pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .heic, .heif. Prefer an absolute path; relative paths use the server's working directory and ~ is not expanded.

folder_id.description: Optional remote Suparse folder ID to assign to the source document.

pdf_password.description: Optional encrypted-PDF password. Treat this as a secret.

source_upload_id.description: Optional source upload ID from an external batch workflow.

upload_batch_id.description: Optional existing upload batch ID from an external batch workflow.

name: start_quick_schema_creation
title: Start Quick Schema Creation
